about_the_game:
This optional Supporter Pack includes some extra goodies for anyone who wants to help out the development team! It doesn't include any in-game content, but we might add some more things to it in the future!

Includes:

  • Development Vault - An interactive app featuring behind-the-scenes content, trivia, and other fun dev stuff. (English only, no controller support.)

  • Prototype Build - An early build of the game from roughly two years prior to release. Expect bugs and jank. (English only, partial controller support.)

  • Desktop Wallpapers - Two slightly different 1080p wallpapers featuring your favorite killer robot. We didn't have the budget for more. 

  • Our Thanks - We couldn't include this in a folder, so just imagine it's there. Thank you for your support!

You can find the Supporter Pack content in the game's install folder.
